cs.t: In the near-term, as you point out, Photoshop is useless on a Retina display (unless you're driving it at full @1x resolution.) I'm glad I've got my trusty old Samsung 213T at home. Even _when_ Adobe gets around to adding Retina support in CS6,  it's clear we'll still need access to @1x monitors to ensure that we're shipping the pixels we think we're shipping. In the long-term, it's hard to predict the adoption curve for high DPI displays.  Especially where the web is concerned, I'm convinced that designers and developers will need to support and test for @1x displays for many years to come -- perhaps a decade or more?
